text.p: The Trace Exporter library is the target system component of $PNAME. The exporter integrates with the On Time RTOS-32 Debug kernel.
An example trace can be found in the On Time RTOS-32 folder.
The exporter library is provided in C source code, and is found in the On Time RTOS-32 folder in the $PNAME installation directory.

A development PC running Microsoft Windows 7 SP1 or newer, with .NET Framework 4.6.1 or later installed, or a PC running Linux with Mono installed (version 5.14 or later is recommended).
A target system running the Debug kernel of RTOS-32.
The Trace Exporter. This is delivered as a C source code with $PNAME.
For detailed instructions on how to use the Trace Exporter, please refer to the comments in the source code files and the readme.txt file. The directory of the Trace Exporter code can be easily found through the Help menu option On Time RTOS-32 Trace Exporter.
